news.title: Sonia Gandhi Recalls 'Indira's Tears' Over Op Blue Star, Akali Dal Hits Back

news.title: Haryana Chief Minister Attacks Bhagwant Mann Over Alleged Drinking Habit

news.title: Five persons, including four girls, drown in irrigation tank in Tiruvannamalai

news.title: Six months into its rule, TVK-led government enjoys public goodwill despite concerns about it being directionless

news.title: Man kills 4-year-old to sell his organs after watching video on making money quickly

news.title: Session Unprorogued for Record 88 Days: Congress
news.summary: Congress has noted the current monsoon session of Parliament has lasted a record 88 days. They accused Union home minister Amit Shah of trying to manipulate support for the delimitation bill.

news.title: 6 Of Family Die As Fire Engulfs House, Attached Store On Diwali In Maharashtra
news.summary: The fire broke out at midnight and consumed the family's grocery store, along with their entire home, reducing everything to ashes in an instant.

news.title: Raptadu chainsaw attack victim’s condition improving, says A.P. Health Minister
news.summary: Dressing has been changed for injuries on her head, neck, face, arms, and back. The wounds are healing well and she is responding positively to the treatment, says Satya Kumar Yadav

news.title: Punjab Police Brought 17 Gangsters From Abroad In Past 6 Months: AAP
news.summary: Cabinet Minister and senior AAP leader Harpal Singh Cheema on Monday claimed that Punjab Police had brought back 17 gangsters from foreign countries over the past six months.

news.title: Woman's Body Chopped Into Pieces In Guwahati, Accused Arrested 6 Days Later
news.summary: The accused, Pradip Taye, a resident of Dhemaji who worked as a driver in the Khanapara area of Guwahati, allegedly killed Jeena Baishya on November 1. Her body was found in a drain near Ganesh Mandir in Khanapara on November 7.

news.title: Disha higher education exhibition draws large crowds in Malappuram
news.summary: Disha, organised by the Career Guidance and Adolescent Counselling Cell (CG&AC) under the General Education department, aims to guide students on higher education options after Plus Two, career-oriented courses and scholarships.

news.title: Mamata Banerjee Gets Delhi Police Notice To Record Statement In 2013 Case

news.summary: Paresh Ram Das, an accused in a high-profile rape and extortion case, had been evading law enforcement for 17 days and repeatedly failed to respond to summons issued by police

news.title: Children make up for half of Deepavali eye-injury cases at Hyderabad hospital
